propositions: The review-bot-ops runbook lacks the prod box instance id and region needed for operators to initiate SSM sessions, forcing them to guess values.
The instance id and region exist in terraform (var.aws_region, versions.tf) and ADR-0026 but are not referenced in the operational runbook where SSM deploys are performed.
The autodeploy.sh script body auto-updates via BOT_PATHS rsync, but script-only changes do not trigger a deploy and must be hand-deployed to go live.
The autodeploy installer and systemd unit files are excluded from in-run re-materialization to prevent self-modification races and always require hand-deployment.
Documentation must clarify the SSM connection prerequisites and accurately explain autodeploy self-update mechanics without stating false claims about script exclusion.
